summary: Uranium Royalty Corp. (URC) filed a Form 6-K reporting a material change: on April 16, 2026, it entered into an arrangement agreement to acquire a 92% interest in Sweetwater Royalties LLC from Orion Resource Partners and Ontario Teachers' Pension Plan. The deal implies a 100% enterprise value of ~US$1.9B and an attributable equity value of ~US$1.1B. Consideration is ~US$330M cash plus ~US$813M in New URC Shares at US$3.64/share. The combined entity will be a new U.S. domiciled parent, New URC, listed on Nasdaq. Voting support agreements with key holders are in place. Watch for shareholder approval and regulatory clearances.
